headline.zh: UNI 跌破财库回购基准价至 $5.19，费用开关启动后仍呈净通胀

fullReasoning.en: UNI faces a structural bear case: despite activating the fee switch and burning 114M tokens, it remains net inflationary at +1.97%/year. At $5.19, the $13.26M annual buyback budget only retires 2.56M UNI against 20M in ecosystem emissions. This math gets worse as price falls - a negative reflexive loop the market understands. The -26% weekly dump pushed price below the $5.96 treasury burn anchor, signaling the DAO's own fair value mark may have been optimistic. TVL bleeding -9.38% weekly confirms capital rotation away from Uniswap. The 1.87 long/short ratio shows retail is positioned for a bounce that hasn't materialized. Until real-yield governance passes (converting burns to staker dividends), UNI has no fundamental floor - just hope for a reflexive recovery. The lack of governance momentum on real-yield is telling: the DAO may be reluctant to dilute governance power by rewarding stakers. Short-term oversold conditions exist, but the structural case requires either price recovery above $6.60 (where burns would match emissions) or governance action. Neither is imminent.
fullReasoning.zh: UNI 面临结构性看跌逻辑：尽管已启动费用开关并销毁 1.14 亿枚代币，仍维持 +1.97%/年净通胀。在 $5.19 价位下，$1326 万年度回购预算仅能销毁 256 万枚 UNI，而生态系统年度增发为 2000 万枚。这一数学关系随价格下跌而恶化——形成负向反身性循环，市场深谙此理。-26% 周跌幅将价格推至 $5.96 财库回购基准价之下，表明 DAO 自身的公允价值标记可能过于乐观。TVL 周流失 -9.38% 确认资本正从 Uniswap 转出。1.87 多空比显示散户押注反弹，但反弹未曾兑现。在真实收益治理提案通过（将销毁转为质押分红）之前，UNI 无基本面底部——仅靠反身性复苏的希冀支撑。治理层面缺乏真实收益动能颇具启示：DAO 可能不愿通过奖励质押者来稀释治理权力。短期存在超卖状态，但结构性多头案例需要价格回升至 $6.60 以上（使销毁匹配增发）或治理行动。两者均非近期可期。
